notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls app 554620 "Dawn" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it. The store list also has "Life is Strange: Before the Storm Remastered" (app 1265930, schema "CerbBTS") with the same 34 achievements; RAWG treats the Remaster as a separate game, so the original app was used. None of the 34 Steam achievements is hidden: 30 are optional graffiti (ten per episode) and 4 are episode completions. StrategyWiki has nothing under "Life is Strange: Before the Storm" but has a stub under "Life Is Strange: Before the Storm" (capital I, completion stage 0); only its Table of Contents is written. That contents page and RAWG's "Life is Strange: Before the Storm - Farewell" entry are the sources for the Farewell chapter, which has no achievements. life-is-strange.fandom.com redirects "Life Is Strange: Before the Storm" to "Life is Strange: Before the Storm", with about 86 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
